'''Hu Barran'''<ref>Last name finally given in {{11|29}}</ref> is one of the stablemen at the [[Winespring Inn]]. His brother is [[Tad Barran|Tad]].

== Appearance ==
He is lanky.{{ref/book|4|44}}

== Activities ==
When [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] and [[Tamlin al'Thor]] come to Emond's Field, Hu and Tad take [[Bela]] and the wagon to the Whiespring Inn's stable.{{ref/book|1|2}} As the al'Thors are leaving, Tam briefly speaks with the brothers.{{ref/book|1|4}}

When [[Perrin Aybara]] returns to Emond's Field, he hears Hu and Tad working in the stable.{{ref/book|4|29}} Later, he and his brother bring out [[Stepper]] and [[Swallow]] for Perrin and [[Faile Bashere|Faile]].{{ref/book|4|44}}

Hu helps defend Emond's Field against the invading [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|4|56}}

He [[Traveling|Travels]] through [[Jur Grady]]'s gateway to join the rest of the [[Two Rivers]] men taken by Perrin Aybara. He also participates in the [[Battle of Malden]].{{ref/book|11|29}} Hu and [[Darl Coplin]] are manning a guard post when Perrin is inspecting his camp.{{ref/book|13|10}}
